description: Points the domain at the Helm-hosted site (A record on the apex) and, in the email group, lets the site send mail from the domain: the signing key at resend._domainkey, the bounce return path at send (MX + SPF), and a monitor-only DMARC policy applied only when the domain has none.
variableDescription: %ip%: the anycast IPv4 of the host serving the site (read live from the host at connect time and signed); %dkim%: the base64 public half of the per-domain DKIM key the mail provider minted (without the leading p=); %region%: the mail provider's sending region, e.g. us-east-1
